build_hosted_vllm_embedding_config: build a HostedVLLMEmbeddingConfig instance to configure hosted VLLM embedding API calls
validate_hosted_vllm_environment: validate the environment for HostedVLLMEmbeddingConfig by setting headers and api key
build_embedding_request_url: build the complete URL for the Hosted VLLM embeddings endpoint with api base and model
